scope: 2D conditioned-source input only; not a game-quality/3D asset result
pose: single frontal T-pose, empty visible hands, complete boots
controls_over_old_text_to_model: single visual specification of adult face/hair direction, body proportions and color/material hierarchy
actual right-closing cross-collar overlap, continuous shoulder/elbow cloth and tapered cuff supplied in image
separate visible empty palms/fingers and complete shoes, no weapon fusion or cropped extremities
neutral diffuse photograph-style light-gray background, no UI/text/multiple figures/pedestal

input_references.role: accepted clothing/hair design only; no text/multiple figures/weapon copied
current adult face and tied-hair identity direction

boundary: Root checks OV balance and actual CLI image/multiview capability
Root reviews dry-run and owns any paid call
no side/back images generated without capability-based decision
image-generation identity direction is not a promise of same geometry/rig or exact biometric identity
not proof of posterior structure, cloth topology, skinning or 3D quality

independent_visual_review.observed: single adult full body, front T-pose, all fingers and boot soles visible, neutral gray background, no weapon/text/random white blotches
limits: front only; back, palm-back and hidden inner cloth require inference
soft shading present; not an albedo texture
